Microsoft: Record Fiscal 1998 Revenue and Income
sources.notes: Contemporary earnings release: fiscal 1998 revenue $14.48 billion, net income $4.49 billion, Office 97 demand, Windows NT growth, and June 25 Windows 98 release.

Company archive of the contemporary report. Pentium II and Pentium with MMX drove 1997 processor growth; Celeron and Pentium II Xeon expanded the range in 1998. Fiscal 1998 revenue $26.3 billion and profit $6.1 billion, down from $6.9 billion in 1997. Archive path is modern; facts concern 1996–1998.
